narrative.overview:
LOREKEEP is a local-first desktop writing sanctuary built around a Standard Dark Desktop visual system and a Hybrid Floating Workspace. Instead of trapping the writer inside permanent multi-pane sidebars, dense tool drawers, or neon gaming chrome, the interface layers calm neutral dark slate surfaces separated by crisp 1px translucent hairlines and holds a single disciplined indigo accent in reserve for primary actions, active navigation, and keyboard focus.

The density adapts to the task in front of the writer. Management views (Hub Workspace, Games Library, Collections & Tags, Archive) organize content in clean, generous 1100px stages with linear hover-elevated document rows and 3:4 box-art game cards; once inside the Immersive Editor, navigation chrome recedes quietly on typing activity and disappears completely in fullscreen Focus Mode so prose commands the entire viewport.

Confirmed visual rejections from the product and built surface: no permanent left or right navigation sidebars, no neon RGB gamer glows or hard offset shadows, no AI assistant badges or promotional banners, no browser-white flash or unstyled light OS form popups, and no uppercase eyebrow kickers above section headings.
keyCharacteristics: Eight-step neutral dark slate tonal ladder from recessed inputs (#101116) to active Floating Dock state (#343a4c), separated by 1px white-alpha hairlines.
Disciplined indigo primary accent (#5b6ef5 for indicators and focus; deepened #4b5ee8 fill for WCAG AA >= 4.5:1 white button labels).
Hybrid Floating Workspace: 56px frosted top bar, centered 1100px viewport, bottom floating capsule Dock 20px above the floor, and Ctrl + K Command Palette.
Readable Figtree sans UI and prose paired with optional Source Serif 4 long-form editor voice and JetBrains Mono strictly for keyboard caps and tabular counters.
Adaptive chrome recession during continuous typing (top bar, ribbon, meta strip, and dock fade back gently and wake immediately on pointer move, hover, or keyboard focus).
Dark-native browser surface theming across PWA manifest, caret, text selection, focus rings, scrollbars, and portaled custom dropdowns.

rules.name: The Deepened CTA Fill Rule
rules.body: Use the luminous indigo accent (#5b6ef5) for focus outlines, active dock indicators, blockquote bars, and accent icons, but always use the deepened fill (#4b5ee8) behind white primary button text to guarantee WCAG AA contrast (>= 4.5:1).

rules.name: The Neutral Slate Discipline Rule
rules.body: Keep 90%+ of every screen in layered neutral dark slate and off-white ink; reserve indigo for active state, focus, and primary triggers, and confine user-picked cover/collection swatches strictly to small dots, 3:4 cover fallback accents, and subtle hero washes.

rules.name: The Mono Boundary Rule
rules.body: Reserve JetBrains Mono strictly for keyboard shortcut caps (.lk-kbd), tabular count pills, and inline or fenced code inside prose; never use monospace for headings, navigation labels, or body copy.

rules.name: The Calm Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Keep page titles, panel headings, button labels, and Command Palette group headers in sentence case with zero uppercase eyebrow kickers; all-caps tracking is reserved solely for the LOREKEEP brand wordmark and 3:4 game cover monograms.

rules.name: The No-Sidebar Workspace Rule
rules.body: All top-level navigation lives in the 56px sticky top bar, the centered bottom Floating Dock, and the Ctrl + K Command Palette; every primary viewport reserves 108px of bottom clearance (--dock-clearance) so scrollable content never collides with the floating capsule.

rules.name: The Typing-Calm Recession Rule
rules.body: During continuous writing inside the Immersive Editor, surrounding chrome dims softly (top bar 0.22, editor ribbon 0.14, meta strip 0.25, Floating Dock 0.28 with a 6px downward nudge) and wakes cleanly on pointer movement, hover, or focus—or vanishes completely in fullscreen Focus Mode.

rules.name: The Flat-Panels, Lifted-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Static content panels rest flat on the canvas via tonal slate contrast and 1px hairline borders without drop shadows; soft dark ambient shadows appear only on floating chrome (Floating Dock, Focus pill, toasts), portaled menus, modal dialogs, primary CTAs, and hover-lifted game cards.

rules.name: The Concentric Radius Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Step corners progressively outward from nested micro-elements (5px kbd caps, 6px small controls and tags) through standard inputs and buttons (8px), cards and rows (11px), panels and modals (14px), to the Floating Dock capsule (16px housing 10px items) and full pills (999px).

rules.name: The Dark-Native Browser Surface Rule
rules.body: Every browser-controlled surface—document canvas, PWA theme-color, text selection, typing caret, focus outline, scrollbars, and select dropdown menus—must stay dark-themed so native light OS popups or white flashes never break the workspace.

dos: Do ground new surfaces on the eight-step neutral slate ladder (--bg-recessed through --bg-active) paired with 1px white-alpha hairline borders (--border-subtle, --border-default, --border-strong).
Do use --accent-fill (#4b5ee8) with --accent-ink (#ffffff) for primary CTA buttons and --accent (#5b6ef5) for focus outlines, active dock bars, checkmarks, and prose blockquotes.
Do preserve 108px bottom clearance (--dock-clearance) on main views and route new sections through the Floating Dock and Ctrl + K Command Palette rather than adding a permanent sidebar.
Do use the portaled SelectField component (or an equivalent custom dark listbox) instead of native HTML <select> elements so dropdown menus match --bg-elevated and --shadow-dialog.
Do pair tabular-nums with JetBrains Mono for shortcut caps and count badges, and use inline two-step confirmation for destructive delete actions instead of disruptive browser confirm() dialogs.
Do respect @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) by keeping all transitions driven by --t-fast (140ms), --t-base (210ms), and --ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)).
donts: Don't introduce permanent left or right navigation sidebars or multi-pane chrome that competes with the centered 1100px workspace and Immersive Editor.
Don't add uppercase eyebrow kickers above page or panel headings, or apply text-transform: uppercase to buttons, tags, or group labels.

Don't use hard offset shadows, neon indigo outer glows on containers, or bright multi-stop gradients on buttons and chrome (subtle gradients belong solely to 3:4 game cover fallbacks and the Game Detail hero wash).
Don't trigger modal popups, toasts, or forced autocorrect interruptions while the user is actively typing inside the Immersive Editor.
Don't use raw unstyled <select> menus or omit theme-color/color-scheme dark metadata, which reintroduce jarring light OS surfaces inside a dark desktop PWA.
Don't invent secondary or neon brand accent hues for system chrome; user-picked swatches from ACCENT_SWATCHES are strictly for manual game covers and collection identity dots.
